nodes.long_description:
Tennis Esports simulates and feels like real tennis for both tennis players, gamers and fans to enjoy Tennis in the VR Metaverse.

Join our global community and leaderboard. Play live matches, arcade target games in any stadium you can imagine or even play against yourself with MirrorPlay©.

Practice your virtual and physical game from beginner to advanced tutorials, real time technique analysis or receive coaching in VR.

Enhance your experience and use the Tennis Racquet VR©, a 3D printed racquet handle that is weighted like a tennis racquet and become the best in the world in the Tennis Esports Pro Tour!

Tennis Esports gets everybody active and playing tennis from virtually anywhere!
Simply download the app to join the Tennis Metaverse today!

Want to chat with others? Got an idea for a new court? Tell the developers directly by going to our Discord server:
 https://discord.gg/nM7ecSjf

nodes.change_log:
Version 2026.10.1.5 brings some more improvements.

📈 Improvements
• Reduced grip button sensitivity to help prevent accidental presses.
• Adjusted overly bright environments for more comfortable viewing.
🎯 Bug Fixes
• Event branding now loads correctly again.
• Fixed flags in the Player VS Player panel.

---

Version 2026.10.1 is here, because apparently bugs don’t fix themselves, but we do.

🎯 Bug Fixes
• Fixed shots lacking power in some situations.
• Fixed shots being incorrectly called as aces.
• Fixed an issue with the Spectator Rankings.

---

We’ve been quiet for a while, but behind the scenes we’ve been working on a long list of improvements for version 2026.10.0. This update brings your first unlockable player Skills and private events, alongside improved physics, performance, and fixes throughout the app.

🎁 New Features
• Unlock your first player Skills: Offensive, Defensive, and All Out Attack playstyles. These change court positioning, contact point, recovery style, and whether you take the ball earlier or later in its trajectory.
• Adjust serve and return positions with the thumbstick, including diagonal movement, and save your preferred positions for subsequent points.
• Earn Spectator Points when others watch your matches and climb the Spectator Rankings.
• A new Spectator board shows how many people are watching and whether your match is live on Twitch.
• Join private events and tournaments organized by Tennis Esports through Discord, bringing larger groups together for special ranked matches. Browse active, upcoming, and past events, and easily match up with fellow participants using predefined settings.
• Find important information about playing Tennis Esports in the new central Info and Help area.

📈 Improvements
• Expanded the return movement area beyond the baseline and sidelines.
• Simplified access keys to one gameplay key and one AI Commentary key. Buy keys in bulk at a reduced price, with existing keys automatically converted to the new types.
• Players are now introduced on Twitch at the start of a match.
• Each replay recording now contains a single match. Rematches start a new recording.

⚛️ Physics and Performance
• Upgraded to Unity 6 incl. SDKs and package updates.
• Improved performance throughout the app.
• The ball can now rest and roll on your racket.
• Reduced excessive ball spin.
• Player movement now favors half-volleys over deep, low volleys.
• Added environment collisions across stadiums, match and exercise courts, Mirrorplay and Hit ’EmAll.

🎯 Bug Fixes
• Fixed an issue where the Online Match UI sometimes failed to load.
• Small thumbstick movements no longer block movement toward the ball.
• Fixed several UI errors.
• Fixed spectators in the stands appearing black or flickering.
• Fixed the ball passing through the racket after a point was evaluated.
• A long list of additional bug fixes and improvements throughout the app.

Return to court, explore the new playstyles, and try the improvements for yourself!
🎾 Your Tennis Esports Team
